title: Modeled TargetContract
description: Legacy behavior-model contract for a proposed authorization envelope. It is non-authoritative; protocol-v1 authority admission uses typed signed grants instead.

kind.description: The legal basis for touching this target. 'benchmark' is a locally-owned test target.

reference.description: URL of the program scope, path to the permission grant, or benchmark id.

in_scope.description: Explicit assets that may be analyzed (repos, hosts, contract addresses, packages).

out_of_scope.description: Explicit exclusions. Anything not in_scope is out of scope by default regardless of this list.

permitted_actions.description: The action classes AQUILA will allow. poc_execution runs only in the isolation tier.

disclosure_channel.description: Where a confirmed finding is disclosed. Disclosure remains a separate human-authorized effect.
